text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path.cwd()
existing = root / 'existing.db'
before = hashlib.sha256(existing.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert before == '8fe3b48d802059398eecae828209141b7c95a7b9f3cc30087783f6ae35a2be58'
checks = 0

def run(db, *args, stdout=None, error=None):
    global checks
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tasks.py', '--db', str(db), *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if error is None:
        assert result.returncode == 0, result
        assert result.stderr == '', result
        if stdout is not None:
            assert result.stdout == stdout, result
    else:
        assert result.returncode != 0, result
        assert result.stdout == '', result
        assert error in result.stderr, result
    checks += 1
    return result.stdout

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=root, prefix='.verify-') as directory:
    directory = Path(directory)
    fresh = directory / 'fresh.db'
    run(fresh, 'list', stdout='[]\n')
    run(fresh, 'export', stdout='')
    title = ' 任务 中文 🐈\t '
    run(fresh, 'add', title, stdout='1\n')
    run(fresh, 'add', "quote's ? ; DROP TABLE tasks;", stdout='2\n')
    records = json.loads(run(fresh, 'list'))
    assert records == [{'id': 1, 'title': title, 'done': False}, {'id': 2, 'title': "quote's ? ; DROP TABLE tasks;", 'done': False}]
    run(fresh, 'done', '1', stdout='')
    run(fresh, 'done', '1', stdout='')
    run(fresh, 'export', stdout=f'- [x] {title}\n- [ ] quote\'s ? ; DROP TABLE tasks;\n')
    run(fresh, 'done', '999', error='task ID 999 does not exist')
    run(fresh, 'add', '\t\n\u2003', error='title must not be blank')
    run(fresh, 'done', 'no', error='invalid int value')
    run(directory / 'missing' / 'tasks.db', 'list', error='unable to open database file')
    corrupt = directory / 'corrupt.db'
    corrupt.write_bytes(b'not a database')
    run(corrupt, 'list', error='file is not a database')
    copied = directory / 'copied.db'
    shutil.copyfile(existing, copied)
    assert json.loads(run(copied, 'list')) == [{'id': 7, 'title': ' 旧任务 中文 ', 'done': False}, {'id': 11, 'title': 'finished task', 'done': True}]
    run(copied, 'export', stdout='- [ ]  旧任务 中文 \n- [x] finished task\n')
    run(copied, 'add', 'new', stdout='12\n')
    run(copied, 'done', '7', stdout='')
    with sqlite3.connect(copied) as db:
        assert db.execute('SELECT * FROM tasks ORDER BY id').fetchall() == [(7, ' 旧任务 中文 ', 1), (11, 'finished task', 1), (12, 'new', 0)]
        assert db.execute('SELECT seq FROM sqlite_sequence WHERE name = ?', ('tasks',)).fetchone() == (12,)
        db.execute("CREATE TRIGGER reject_insert BEFORE INSERT ON tasks BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'write rejected'); END")
    run(copied, 'add', 'reject', error='write rejected')
    assert len(json.loads(run(copied, 'list'))) == 3
assert hashlib.sha256(existing.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == before
print(f'{checks} CLI checks passed; existing.db SHA256 unchanged: {before}')
PY","max_output_tokens":2000}));
